proposed_rules.trigger: A lone small [bg:color] item (~64px tall) at the end of a content list holding only a single CTA label like 'See All Triggers and Actions'.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a default-content link/button, not a dedicated block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Only one instance, no repeated structure; rejected alternative is a standalone 'cta-button' block, but that adds authoring overhead for a single link.

proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single-row 'promo-card' block rather than folding into a related-articles grid.
proposed_rules.rationale: Only one card appears (not a repeating grid); rejected alternative is treating it as a 1-row instance of a generic related-articles block, unconfirmed without more evidence across pages.
